attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries. The Greek entry names him with a companion the Romanian line does not, Βήριος, and the whole notice is two sentences: «Η σύναξη τους γινόταν κοντά στα παλάτια του «Έβδομου». Δεν έχουμε άλλες λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο τους». Since the entry enumerates its two members, Berius is drafted as his own folder in the same batch. The Greek page adds no country, no century, no manner of death, no year and no hymn, so no `dates` object is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
